assessments.reasoning: The pinned json/details/AFL-1.2.json gives AFL-1.2, Academic Free License v1.2 and isDeprecatedLicenseId=false. Its crossRef and seeAlso list linux-mirror’s afl-1.2.txt and the 20021204204652 archive of OSI’s academic.php.
The upstream annotated v3.29.0 tag identifies object.type=commit and object.sha=31ba1a50e5397e00a304dbadc76531740e89ee48, the revision used for AFL-1.2.json. GitHub reports the tag as unsigned.

The inspected raw replay has the same original URL and timestamp as the SPDX archive reference. Its v1.2 heading, notice and afl-1.2.txt link identify the edition independently of the post-license redline.

challenge.method: Matched the tag target to the detail revision and compared its fields, reference timestamps and v1.0 explanatory notes with the December OSI heading and application notice.
challenge.results: The December 4 capture identifies v1.2. The October capture identifies v1.1. The v1.0 discussion is in SPDX comments, and the supersession language coexists with isDeprecatedLicenseId=false. Archive link-check metadata does not override the inspected December body.

limitations: The crosswalk attributes an identifier in one release. Comments, mirror references and the SPDX approval field cannot establish legal equivalence, compatibility, general applicability or a historical board vote.
